verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's own SDK documents creating virtual and physical corporate cards and managing cardholders through the API, and its marketing page claims spending control and flexible limits. However, nothing shows the cards are debit cards tied to the account balance, API-level spend controls are not documented, and digital wallet support is absent. missing for 10: digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) provisioning, documented API spend-control/limit endpoints, explicit debit-card linkage to the account balance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, accounts come with cards — issue virtual and physical debit cards tied to the account through the same API, with spend controls and digital wallet support

citations.quote: CorporateHolders: Manage cardholders ... CorporateCards: Create virtual and/or physical cards
Unlimited physical and virtual cards with full spending control, flexible limits, detailed reports, and 1.5% cashback on all purchases.
